package.author: Talyh
package.description: A text editor for code, data and documents.

en-US.author: Talyh
en-US.description: A text editor for code, data and documents.
en-US.longDescription:
The is a desktop text editor for code, data and documents, built to stay
responsive on files far larger than an editor usually accepts. The core and
eight bundled plugins are free, with no account and no registration.
en-US.name: The
en-US.releaseNotes:
1.5.0
current1 November 2026
- macOS 14.4 Sonoma or later is now required, up from macOS 13 Ventura. On macOS 13 through 14.3, version 1.4.3 does not offer this update, and Check for Updates names the macOS version it needs. Earlier versions cannot tell and may offer it: on those Macs, install 1.4.3 instead
- The editor now runs on Qt 6.12
- Windows requirements are unchanged: Windows 10 or 11, x64
